node.statement: Proposition 1.7 (Hayashi high probability): Given n copies of |psi> in C^d, Hayashi's algorithm outputs |v> with |<v|psi>|^2 >= 1-epsilon with probability >= 1-delta when n = O((d + log(1/delta))/epsilon). Proof: The overlap |<v|psi>|^2 follows the Beta(1, d-1) distribution rescaled by (n+d)/(n+1) [ZS00]. By Skorski's Bernstein-type concentration bound for the Beta distribution [Sko23], Pr[|<v|psi>|^2 < 1-epsilon] <= exp(-n*epsilon/(2(d-1))) for epsilon < (d-1)/(n+d). Setting n = C*(d + log(1/delta))/epsilon for suitable constant C gives the result.
